name: Fix mission.approve gate scoping (checks active mission instead of target mission)
goal: intake.ts mission.approve resolves missionId = action.missionId || activeMission?.id; CLI passes no missionId, so it inspects the ACTIVE mission's executing expeditions, wrongly blocking approval of an UNRELATED mission. Fix: resolve the target mission from the approved draft/snapshot and check THAT mission for executing expeditions, so a mission with no executing expeditions can be approved even when another mission has a live expedition. See attached finding.
